reviews.text: I had to replace my pool pump after it went out in October. I had purchased a new pump from Amazon, but once I started installing it found that the old connectors and several hoses would no longer work. Leslie Pools in Allen doesn’t carry what I needed so they referred me to Crown Pools who had exactly what I needed and they were very helpful. It’s now all hooked up and working properly.
reviews.author: Deborah Blanquie

reviews.text:
Cade and Kate have always taken great care of me every time that I visited their store.

They are always honest and only offer what I am needing for my pool, without the added pressure like I felt from other pool stores.

I have been shopping at the Allen store for 5 years now,  and I will not buy pool chemicals from anywhere else.  A++
reviews.author: Chris Passonno

reviews.text:
New small pool owner and I had no idea how to add chemicals and keep the water right. I walked into crown pools, and the two young people behind the counter could not have been more helpful. Told me exactly how much of what chemical to put in to maintain the water. With their help, my pool water is
sparkling clean. They tested my water and knew exactly what I needed. Write down to the amount of chemical.
reviews.author: deb

reviews.text: I want to say Thank You to Kate for the awesome job she did. It was a pleasure working with her on getting our above ground pool replaced. NOW, I want to give a special thanks to Joe the pool installer and his crew. Joe did an especially great job installing our pool. With the weather causing several delays he got to us as soon as he could. Joe was so very nice and polite and courteous. I think he went above and beyond the average installation. Our previous pool install was in 2015. It was our first pool and I had no idea how things should have been done. Based on this current install that Joe did I can see that the first installers did a crappy job especially with the plumbing of the system. Kudos to Joe. You did a great job!!
reviews.author: Stephen Bass

reviews.text:
We purchased a 24' Round above ground pool.  We love it.  The experience around the purchase was excellent.  Kyle, the manager, is very knowledgeable.  Every question I posed he had a solid and clear answer.  He didn't push upgrades on me.  He explained the benefit and let me make the decision based on my needs.  It is hard to find honest sales folks these days and Crown Pools is a place you can find them.

I installed the pool myself over a weekend and on Sunday we found that 2 support pieces were missing from the sealed box.  This was not a fault of Crown Pools as these pieces were missing from the factory.  I contacted Kyle and he immediately started finding the parts at other stores and got them to me early the next morning.  This helped save me money by not having to extend my equipment rental.  Crown Pools really cares about their customers especially after the sale.

If you are in the market for a new pool or need to maintain your current pool, I highly recommend Crown Pools in Allen, TX.
reviews.author: Kory Olson

reviews.text: Bought the new liner for my above ground pool from crown pools - they were helpful and knowledgable in getting me what I needed. And they referred me to Marcos Coronado for installation. Marcos and his team were great!  Everything was priced reasonably and it all was done in two days. Other companies had declined the work because i have a deck around one side of the pool but that was no issue with these guys. Everyone was helpful and very professional! My pool looks great again!!
reviews.author: Cathy Ries

reviews.text:
A+ recommendation for Crown Pools in Allen for an outstanding replaster job (check out the pics)!!! If customer service is important to you, then you should take this review to heart!!!

I am NOT a pool expert so I needed a lot of "hand-holding" throughout the entire process; and Crown exceeded my very high expectations. They were extremely patient with me and my multitude of questions (many times focusing on the same subject over and over); and always made me feel like I was their #1 customer.

Special shout out to some great folks:
Talbot - managed the entire construction process and put up with my 1,000 questions with a great degree of respect and impeccable customer service. Talbot was ALWAYS in contact with me from start to finsh with text, email, phone calls, and personal visits to inspect how everything was progressing.

Kyle - Manager of the Allen store who MADE ME FEEL LIKE AN ABSOLUTE SUPER HERO every time I walked in the door; and was instrumental on helping me balance my pool chemicals after refill to perfection (and thus saving me $$$). Poor Kyle probably put up with more questions from me than Talbot did and was always SUPER NICE and incredibly helpful. His entire staff in the Allen store is awesome!!!!!!!!!

Chase - who did my propane pool / spa heater install and is a fantastic professional representative of Crown. He was the first person on the scene for my remodel job and was super polite, professional, and clearly set the stage for a wonderful customer service experience.

Thank you to the entire Allen area Crown Team for my awesome new pool renovation and A+++ customer service experience!!!!
reviews.author: Sean Mayo

reviews.text: I have known the owner since 2006 when I bought my house in Allen and they have always treated me amazing. It's the only place I go when I need supplies and also for repairs. Thank you Crown Pools!
reviews.author: Fernando De Los Santos
